description: Restricts patching to a learned area of the rack: a module moved outside that area is disabled, and enabled again when it is moved back inside.
notes: nothing is restricted until a patching area is learned or a limit is switched on.
menu: Learn — drag across the rack to mark the usable area; Size sets it as a width in HP and a height in rows, Size Presets offer set sizes, and Reset removes the restriction.
Cable limit and Module limit — each is switched on with Enabled and given a maximum, and the most recently added ones are removed whenever that maximum would be passed.
